articles.title: Analysis on radiation protection of FLASH treatment in conventional proton therapy facilities
articles.summary: This study demonstrates that existing conventional shielding for the Varian ProBeam system is sufficient for FLASH irradiation, ensuring radiation safety for staff and the surrounding environment. The findings provide a justification for implementing FLASH techniques in current proton therapy clinical settings.

articles.title: A cell-type resolved proton RBE model for potential clinical application
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a cell-type resolved RBE model that accounts for variations in cellular repair capabilities. This model shows strong agreement with experimental data, offering a more precise approach to RBE determination for clinical proton therapy.

articles.title: Differentiable Autoplanning Algorithm for Proton Therapy Based on Deep Learning: A Proof-of-Concept
articles.summary: This study introduces a deep learning framework capable of joint, gradient-based optimization of proton therapy beam parameters. The methodology lays the groundwork for next-generation automated treatment planning systems with clinical potential.

articles.title: Angle-Dependent Dose Transformer Algorithm for Fast Proton Therapy Dose Calculations
articles.summary: The researchers developed a beamlet angle-aware deep learning algorithm that provides Monte Carlo-level accuracy for proton dose calculations. This approach significantly improves calculation speed while maintaining precision, particularly for thoracic treatment plans.

articles.title: Experimental validation of time-driven proton PBS FLASH delivery on a clinical proton therapy system
articles.summary: This study validates a time-driven delivery method for proton PBS at ultra-high dose rates. The approach allows for reproducible dosimetry suitable for both clinical and preclinical radiobiological research on FLASH effects.

articles.title: Radiation therapy quality assurance (RT QA) of adjuvant fractionated radiotherapy for WHO grade 2 atypical meningioma in the ROAM/EORTC1308 trial
articles.summary: This study underscores the critical importance of prospective independent central reviews (ICRs) to ensure high-quality and consistent radiotherapy delivery across clinical sites for complex tumors. The researchers conclude that pre-trial QA alone is insufficient for robust trial outcomes in uncommon tumor cohorts.

articles.title: Artificial intelligence in image-guided cervical interventional radiotherapy: a systematic review
articles.summary: This systematic review explores the current landscape of AI applications in image-guided cervical brachytherapy. The authors emphasize that while AI shows promise for workflow automation, further clinical validation is necessary before integration into standard practice.

articles.title: Spot size reduction and minibeam creation in a proton PBS nozzle using multipole permanent magnets
articles.summary: This study explores the use of multipole permanent magnets within a proton pencil beam scanning nozzle to reduce spot size. The proposed design facilitates the creation of modulated beams and proton minibeams for potential clinical or preclinical use.

articles.title: When toxicity limits cure: Repositioning radiation in esophageal and rectal cancers by proton therapy
articles.summary: This article highlights the clinical potential of proton therapy to reduce radiation-induced toxicity to critical organs in esophageal and rectal cancer treatments. It explores how leveraging proton beam physics can improve patient quality of life and outcomes compared to conventional radiotherapy.

articles.title: Is full re-optimization necessary in adaptive radiotherapy for head and neck cancer? A systematic review
articles.summary: A systematic review evaluates the necessity of full re-optimization during adaptive radiotherapy for head and neck cancer. The study synthesizes current evidence on dosimetric and clinical outcomes to help determine optimal adaptive workflows.

articles.title: Yttrium-90 Radioembolization for Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Clinical Evidence, Evolving Indications, and Research-Frontier Mapping
articles.summary: This review summarizes the clinical role of Yttrium-90 radioembolization in treating hepatocellular carcinoma. It highlights evidence supporting personalized dosimetry and the therapy's expanding utility as a locoregional treatment and potential partner for systemic therapy.

articles.title: Experimental feasibility study of proton therapy range verification by a digital tracking calorimeter prototype
articles.summary: This research investigates the use of a silicon-pixel-based sampling calorimeter for proton range verification. By measuring secondary radiation, this technique offers a potential method to ensure the Bragg peak is accurately delivered according to the treatment plan.

articles.title: Evaluation of Dose to Medium and Dose to Water with the Acuros XB Algorithm for SABR: Clinical and Phantom-Based Observations
articles.summary: This study evaluates the clinical and dosimetric impact of reporting dose to medium (Dm) versus dose to water (Dw) using the Acuros XB algorithm in stereotactic ablative body radiotherapy (SABR). It provides essential insights for medical physicists regarding the implications of reporting modes on treatment planning and protocol consistency.

articles.title: Cardiovascular Effects of Childhood Radiotherapy
articles.summary: This review provides a comprehensive analysis of the long-term cardiovascular risks associated with radiotherapy in pediatric and adolescent cancer survivors. It highlights the importance of understanding the mechanisms of radiation-induced cardiac injury to guide surveillance and survivorship care strategies.

articles.title: Linac performance benchmarking: Feasibility of a web-based tool for comparison of local machine performance check (MPC) results with the global community
articles.summary: This study demonstrates the feasibility of a web-based tool for benchmarking linear accelerator performance against a global database. The tool allows clinics to identify machine trends and may assist under-resourced centers in maintaining safe and accurate radiotherapy delivery.

articles.title: A generalizable 3D dose prediction across heterogeneous cohorts: A framework developed for the 2025 AAPM GDP-HMM challenge
articles.summary: Researchers developed a generalizable 3D dose prediction framework that meets strict runtime requirements while preserving geometric plan features and clinical endpoints. The study highlights the role of engineered loss formulations in achieving cross-institutional model generalization.

articles.title: Daily Multi-Leaf Collimator positional error prediction using machine learning
articles.summary: Researchers developed a machine learning model using LightGBM to predict multi-leaf collimator (MLC) positional errors. This approach offers a potentially efficient tool for patient-specific quality assurance in intensity-modulated radiotherapy.

articles.title: Medicare change could cost standalone proton therapy centers millions
articles.summary: Proposed Medicare pricing adjustments could result in a nearly 30% reduction in reimbursement for standalone proton therapy centers starting in 2027. Stakeholders express concern that this policy may impact the financial sustainability of non-hospital facilities and potentially restrict patient access to proton radiation services.
